bounded_leaf.tested_scope: Deterministic role-local synthetic fixtures only. No public sources, repository chronology, other-role state, O/downstream semantics, live rollback-guard backfill, real rollback, external effect, scheduler mutation, wait/retry, or second leaf was used.
bounded_leaf.model: Candidate effect admission requires checkpoint_published=true plus complete current, expected and replay-map bindings for both logical identity and logical generation. Logical identity equality alone is insufficient after ABA; the replay mapping must match the exact current generation.
bounded_leaf.admission_predicate: admit_before_candidate_effect iff checkpoint_published=true AND current_identity,current_generation,expected_identity,expected_generation,current_replay_key,replay_mapping_identity,replay_mapping_generation are all present AND current_identity=expected_identity=replay_mapping_identity AND current_generation=expected_generation=replay_mapping_generation.
bounded_leaf.result: The synthetic matrix distinguishes ordinary stale replay from ABA. Stale K1 fails after A->B and still fails after B->A because generation g1 does not equal current generation g3. Fresh K2 bound to A:g3 is admitted. A replay binding without a generation discriminator fails closed.
bounded_leaf.validated_property: A replay-rotation guard that binds replay keys to a non-reused logical generation, not merely a reusable logical identity, blocks the modeled ABA stale-replay path before candidate adoption/effect while preserving exact published current-generation replay.
limitations: This is a local synthetic model and does not prove how a concrete repository/storage path allocates non-reused generations or atomically publishes them with replay mappings.
It does not test concurrent writers, CAS races, generation-allocation crashes, wraparound/reuse, or real rollback effects.
The live STATE still does not contain an operational rollback_guard binding structure for real candidate-effect admission; this leaf intentionally did not backfill one.
